create_thumbnail_helper: create a ThumbnailHelper instance to fetch panoramic thumbnails from a StreetLearn environment
get_thumbnail: get a thumbnail image ndarray from a StreetLearn environment given a pano_id and heading
initialize_thumbnail_helper: initialize a ThumbnailHelper with width and height attributes for thumbnail reshaping
fetch_streetlearn_thumbnail: fetch a reshaped thumbnail ndarray from StreetLearn using goto, view_image_hwc, and config dimensions
reshape_thumbnail_observation: reshape a flat view_image_hwc observation into a height x width x 3 thumbnail array
